title: Must, have to và should
learningObjectiveVi: Phân biệt nghĩa vụ mạnh với lời khuyên bằng must, have to và should.
learningObjectiveEn: Distinguish strong obligation from advice using must, have to, and should.

morphologyNotes: Use a base verb after a modal; choose should for advice and must or have to for obligation.

uses: Express a rule or strong necessity.
Give advice without imposing an absolute requirement.

usageConstraints: Choose the form from the intended time, meaning, discourse context, and register.

rules.description: Use a base verb after a modal; choose should for advice and must or have to for obligation.
